posts.author: KiZai
posts.title: Judge: Disbanding
posts.html:
The title says it all:

If a current member wishes to pick up the clan and carry on, I will give you full moderator access within this sub-board to do as you please.

I am moving on to other things, I just feel that being in a clan such as this will leave me as a target to Legion and other clans that will rise to power.

No hard feelings.

-KiZai
